mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND (r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id OR r.tenant_id IS NULL) AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0

SELECT DISTINCT r.id AS role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.data_scope FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND (r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id OR r.tenant_id IS NULL) AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0 AND r.role_code IS NOT NULL AND r.role_code != '' AND r.role_code IS NOT NULL AND r.role_code != ''
